candidate.title: Organizer gets duplicate “guests added” email for team bookings because organizer isn’t excluded from team member loop
reports: [advisory] sendaddguestsemails pushes an organizeraddguestsemail with no teammember (organizer) and then loops over calendarevent.team.members sending one per member with no exclusion of the organizer, so the organizer receives the same email twice when they are a team member. organizers of team bookings get duplicate 'guests added' notifications on every guest addition; drift risk if member list already includes the organizer by construction.
